nodes.label: Phase 0c smoke task fixture
nodes.rationale: The smallest task that still exercises the whole loop: read a failing test, locate a one-character bug (`add` returns `a - b`), edit a file, and run the test to see it pass.

nodes.label: The agent must be able to run the test and see it pass
nodes.rationale: pytest.ini is what makes `from calc import add` resolve and the eval image is what supplies pytest. Break either and the fixture is red before the fix and red after it, so a correct run and an idle run leave identical evidence -- which is how Phase 0c scored an environment defect as a model failure. The remedy is to verify the fixture itself (`pytest -q` fails, change calc.py to `a + b`, `pytest -q` passes), not just the harness.

nodes.label: The smoke task directory is a template, not a git repository
nodes.rationale: scripts/smoke_test.py copies it under $HOME and runs `git init` there at run time, deriving base_sha from the commit it just made. Committing it with a .git inside would make git record an embedded-repo gitlink rather than the files, and a hand-written base_sha would go stale the first time the fixture changed.
